# A bicycle route for the hottest day

Took the shaded streets and stopped twice. The distance was shorter than planned and the ride was pleasant. [[Routes]] can retain a heat version without describing the ordinary route as wrong. A useful plan can carry several conditions instead of one ranking that hides whose body and which weather it assumes.
